title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
content: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
content: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
content: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
content: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
content: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
content: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
content: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
content: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
content: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
content: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
content: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
content: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
content: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
content: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
content: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival’s model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
content: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin Rep. title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
content: Bitcoin Magazine Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review Poland's Sejm passed a sanctions bill Friday that lets the interior minister freeze bitcoin and bank funds of people on a national list, and a court appeal would not pause the freeze.
